properties.name: FIELD LOG 2026-10-06: install.sh printed "~/.local/bin is not on your PATH" while it was, in the interactive shell and in a fresh sh
properties.statement: Measured by the field log on the work laptop. Not root-caused. Candidates to measure there: PATH holding a literal `~/.local/bin` (bash expands a tilde in PATH, sh does not, and install.sh's case match compares the literal string), a trailing slash, or a different spelling of the home path. The measurement that separates them: `sh -c 'echo "$PATH"' | tr : '\n' | grep -n local` on that machine.
